[SWS_DM_01954] Configuration of a DTCs failed operation Cycles Tested Since Last Failed as extended data record
⌈
If
the
configuration
parameter
DiagnosticProvidedDataMapping.dat-
aProvider of the corresponding DiagnosticParameter.dataElement is set to
DEM_CYCLES_TESTED_SINCE_LAST_FAILED, the DM shall report the internal value
of the current Operation Cycles Tested Since Last Failed Counter of the contextual DTC
in the respective DiagnosticExtendedDataRecord’s DiagnosticDataElement.
The length of this internal data element is one byte.
⌋

[SWS_DM_01954] Configuration of a DTCs failed Operation Cycles Tested Since Last Failed as extended data record
⌈
If
the
DiagnosticExtendedDataRecordElement
is
referred
by
Di-
agnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.extendedDataRecordElement
and
DiagnosticEdrDataProviderMapping.dataProvider
is
set
to
DEM_CYCLES_TESTED_SINCE_LAST_FAILED, the DM shall report the internal value
of the current Operation Cycles Tested Since Last Failed Counter of
the contextual DTC in the respective extended data record.
The length of this internal data element is one byte.
⌋
